plugins.description: Install the BPA MCP server and register eRegistrations instance profiles.
DS (Display System) MCP server for admin/ops monitoring of eRegistrations application files, workflows, payments, and documents.
GDB (Generic Database Builder) MCP server for managing databases, schemas, and records in eRegistrations.
Graylog MCP server for searching and monitoring logs across eRegistrations instances.

Translations MCP server for eRegistrations — context-aware translation of BPA services (field labels, tooltips, DS system strings, form structure, grids), plus one-command recovery from missing translation bootstrap via translation_global_status / translation_global_reload.
Generate citizen-facing HTML service manuals, batch-generate all service manuals, and export structured Excel documentation for eRegistrations BPA services.
Install the Keycloak Admin MCP server for eRegistrations IAM management.

DevOps and deployment skills for eRegistrations infrastructure — Docker Swarm migration, Bitbucket→GitHub Actions repo migration, mule3-* post-migration alignment (CI/CD + propagator wiring), eRegistrations platform-version instance upgrades (orchestrator + per-env/per-version-pair sub-skills), configuration management, and deployment automation.
Self-service deployment requests on the singlewindow Coolify server.
Session handoff — capture state so any AI agent can continue your work.
Publish HTML or Markdown documents to share.eregistrations.dev and get shareable URLs.

Skills for designing and extending eRegistrations BPA services — including resource history endpoints, audit visibility, and cross-repo (BPA-backend + MCP) feature patterns extracted from working diffs.
Build brand-matched applicant leaflets (explainer pages) for any online or government service, with an optional named voice guide that narrates the page.

Define a product's UX screen by screen: an invariant page schema decided first, then per screen one clickable mobile mockup + one spec fiche, parallel agents copying a bundled reference grammar (mobile phone frame AND desktop app frame — mobile first, desktop derives), preview verification before showing, a regenerable docs compendium + guided tour + team presentations, a same-day decisions journal, and a pre-verbal design check on every screen.

Jira-centered collaboration for humans + Claude sessions: a 15-min watcher that surfaces new ticket comments and PR status changes in your session, plus the team conventions (findings as ticket comments, epic as shared memory).

One front door for eRegulations work — describe the problem in plain English, or run /eregulations:ereg, and the router sends the request to the right knowledge, resolves which instance and version it concerns, and blocks on unsafe hosts, mismatched Admin/Public branches, and unsupported versions before anything runs.
